match_event_url: # Editing sca_events_clean.csv directly does nothing: the pipeline rebuilds it
# from the upstream calendars each run. Put corrections HERE instead.
# Full guide with worked examples: EDITING_EVENTS.md  (READ IT FIRST).
# Tip: edit this in a spreadsheet (Excel / Google Sheets / LibreOffice) so it
# quotes commas for you. Lines whose first cell starts with # are ignored.
#   best    -> match_event_url  (the event's permalink; most durable)
#   else    -> match_source + match_title  (+ match_date YYYY-MM-DD to pin one
#              instance of a title that repeats annually)
#   new_location ......... fixes a vague/wrong address; gets geocoded
#   new_lat + new_lng .... exact pin in decimal degrees (use when no address
#                          will geocode); skips the geocoder entirely
#   both ................. corrected text AND an exact pin
# Example (remove the leading # and edit to use):

note: 'Greater Savannah area' would not geocode; set to the city

new_location: Rancho Park Archery Range, Los Angeles, CA 90064
note: Rancho Park archery range in West LA (the big park S of Century City, N of Cheviot Hills); the venue name won't geocode, so pinned by hand
